scope.definition: 50 definitions ×200 parameter tuples: 8000 long SQL reads +2000 staged transactional analyses. Every case executes its own full query; stage operations are not counted as extra cases.
scope.oracle: DuckDB 1.3.2 built from original deterministic data; numerical tolerance rtol/atol 1e-7; integral counts exact. Full source table comparison plus independently coded market/subscription calculations.
scope.risk_scores: Synthetic analytical scoring recurrences; not production model validation. Every feedback step changes the output score.
scope.pilot_changes: Reserved alias RETENTION renamed to active_retention, and activity-island subtraction explicitly casts ROW_NUMBER to signed BIGINT. Initial pilot failures remain separate, not counted in canonical results.
scope.observational_timing: Main-run query and case times include contention from local DuckDB references and stage/engine work. Isolated measurements, if included, are separate.
scope.stability_limit: Local single-instance execution window; no HA, crash injection or production-size assurance.
